rules.review: mixed_alleles > 0 OR ambiguous_allele_observation > 0 OR callable_marker_count != expected_allele_observed
rules.confirmed_low_depth: all callable markers support expected allele; no conflicts; low_depth + no_coverage > 0
rules.confirmed: all expected terminal markers support expected allele; no non-callable or conflicting markers

notes: The status field records the decision; evidence counts and marker identifiers are stored in separate columns.
Low-depth and uncovered markers are non-callable evidence, not contradictory evidence.
